recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32477 unless Patient Care later revises the broader Condition onset/abatement usage model.
issue_request: FHIR-32477 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for R5 asking the Condition usage note to explain onsetRange/abatementRange. The approved resolution specifically added that Range is generally used to convey an imprecise age range, such as 4 to 6 years old, to the Condition.onset comments.
initial_application: Commit 66b7bfbd38b741a31e37fbefeacd0973bf34bad1, titled "J#38907 update valueset-condition-stage definition; J#32477 update Condition.onset comments", applied the approved sentence to source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml. The Condition resource is active in source/fhir.ini, so that source is in the current build scope.
additional_context: The current source also contains matching abatement Range guidance. That was intentionally added later by FHIR-50437, an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 issue whose resolution said onset already had the needed guidance and abatement should receive similar Period/Range wording. Confluence minutes on the FHIR-32477 vote date reference the issue, and direct Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The combined branch already has the requested onset Range sentence and the related abatement clarification in the active Condition StructureDefinition source, so adding more text would be redundant.
